Subject: Post-call recap - Security posture (SOC2, VPC/on-prem)

Hi Alice - great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's high-level needs. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary need: strict network isolation for PII/NPI workloads, auditability, and contract-level controls.
- Required certifications: SOC 2 Type II + GDPR alignment; potential HIPAA scoping for a subset of data flows.
- Deployment preference: VPC-private deployment (customer VPC peering or Private Connect) or on-prem (air-gapped) for regulated workloads.

What we can provide (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 controls; we can share the Type II summary and evidence for relevant controls.
- GDPR/HIPAA: data processing agreements, processor/subprocessor details, and optional support for data residency.
- Private options: VPC-based private deployment (VPC peering, private link) and an on-prem package supporting air-gapped installs + KMS/HSM integration.

Attachments in this thread: redwood-private-deployment-diagram.pdf (deployment zones & connectivity), SOC2_Type2-summary.pdf (control summary).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send the initial vendor security questionnaire back filled with our answers (we captured Acme's template during the call).
2) We'll attach the deployment diagram and a short SOC 2 summary (see attachments).
3) Let's schedule a follow-up 30-min call with your security and infra leads to walk the diagram and confirm network connectivity options. Please suggest times - we have availability Wed/Thu next week.

If you want a redacted internal runbook or deeper architecture diagram (air-gapped specifics), we can include that after an NDA or as part of the secure drive share.

Thanks - Marcus
Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Post-call recap - Security posture (SOC2, VPC/on-prem)

Hi Alice - looping in Neha from Product Security to cover the controls questions and a few specifics on deployment. Answers inline below, and we attached the SOC2 summary and a deployment diagram.

1) SOC 2 scope: Our current SOC 2 Type II (latest report) covers the production control plane, data plane for hosted and dedicated deployments, logging and backup processes, and change-management controls. We can share the SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) under your standard NDA - attached: SOC2_Type2-summary.pdf. Full reports are shared under NDA only.

2) Vendor SQ: Thanks for the template. We started filling it and attached vendor-sq-acme.xlsx with initial responses. There are a few technical follow-ups (see rows marked NEEDS INFO) around key rotation SLA and encryption in transit specifics; Neha will pick those up.

3) VPC / Private options:
- VPC peering / PrivateLink: We support both. VPC peering is simpler but requires routing setup; PrivateLink offers tighter control (no cross-VPC routing) and fewer config changes on your side. Either option provides private connectivity; choice depends on your infra constraints.
- Network diagram: Attached redwood-private-deployment-diagram.pdf - includes example ports, egress rules, and where KMS/HSM integration occurs. Note that hosted API endpoints still use a control plane over the internet; private deployments can limit data plane egress.
- Air-gapped / on-prem: We offer an on-prem package for customers that need an air-gapped install. That package includes an installer bundle, offline mirrors for model artifacts, and an auditable provisioning process. Operationally, it requires a customer-managed KMS and a secure mechanism for pushing model updates via signed bundles. We can provide a more detailed runbook if you want to evaluate this option.

4) GDPR / Data residency: Yes - we support region-specific private deployments (EU, US, APAC) as part of Redwood Private. For hosted customers that require EU data residency we operate in EU cloud regions and can configure data plane routing to stay in-region. For the Private deployment we can place instances entirely within your EU VPC or on-prem.

Next tangible items from us:
- Updated vendor-sq-acme.xlsx (attached) - please confirm receipt and any rows that need more detail.
- Schedule 30-min deep-dive on Wed 2027-06-23 09:00 AM PST or Thu 2027-06-24 10:30 AM PST - Marcus will send the invite.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
